name: Feature Tabs Timeline
description: Three feature tabs, each driving a five-step vertical timeline (dot plus auto-filling track, 7s per step) that swaps a big tinted card with a title, copy, two buttons, and a floating token product mock.
interactions: three tabs switch the feature set; the active tab gets a brand color and a 3px underline
each tab shows a 5-step vertical timeline; the active step's track fill animates height 0 to 100% over 7s linear, then auto-advances to the next step (wrapping)
clicking a step (or a tab) jumps to it and restarts the fill and the 7s timer
changing step swaps the left card: its tint changes per tab and the text + mock re-fade (wpmn-wsf-fade 400ms, wpmn-wsf-fadeShot 450ms)
the primary button arrow slides on hover; window.__sectionStep(n) drives the step externally
under 900px the grid stacks and the mock goes static; prefers-reduced-motion drops the swap fades and the fill transition
